name: apple-purchase-receipt-verifier
description: Verify Apple in-app purchases locally (StoreKit 2 JWS + legacy PKCS#7 receipts) with zero Apple server calls and zero runtime dependencies

scripts.test:runtimes: npm run runtime:node && npm run runtime:bun && npm run runtime:deno && npm run runtime:workerd-floor && npm run runtime:workerd-compat-v2 && npm run runtime:workerd-latest
scripts.runtime:deno: node scripts/typecheck.mjs && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 run --allow-read runtime-smoke/node-like.mjs
scripts.runtime:workerd-floor: node scripts/typecheck.mjs && node runtime-smoke/run-workerd.mjs workerd@1.20260903.1 2024-09-23 nodejs_compat
scripts.runtime:workerd-compat-v2: node scripts/typecheck.mjs && node runtime-smoke/run-workerd.mjs workerd@1.20260903.1 2023-01-01 nodejs_compat_v2
scripts.runtime:workerd-latest: node scripts/typecheck.mjs && node runtime-smoke/run-workerd.mjs workerd@1.20260903.1 2026-08-01 nodejs_compat
scripts.test:runtimes:web: node scripts/typecheck.mjs && node runtime-smoke/web-node.mjs && node --experimental-vm-modules runtime-smoke/web-edge.mjs && node runtime-smoke/run-web-workerd.mjs workerd@1.20260903.1
